title: Moon's two moments of inertia suggest it was geoengineered

tellings.quote: I am willing to consider that the moon has been geoengineered.

plain: The idea here is that the Moon may have been deliberately shaped or rebuilt by someone, which the story's title links to the Moon having two "moments of inertia", a physics measure of how mass is spread inside a spinning body. The researcher Randall Carlson raises it on the show without citing a source, and puts it carefully: "I am willing to consider that the moon has been geoengineered." If it were so, our nearest neighbour in space would be an artefact rather than a natural object.
